facts.fact: Google describes Google Analytics as the go-to platform for millions of website and app owners (vendor claim, no exact count given).
facts.quote: Google Analytics is the go-to platform for millions of website and app owners seeking to gain a deeper understanding of their website and app performance.

facts.fact: Google states that it provides free courses to help users get started with Google Analytics, via Skillshop Analytics Academy.
facts.quote: Google provides free courses to help you get started with Google Analytics.

facts.fact: The Google tag (gtag.js) is installed to measure website interactions in Google Analytics.
facts.quote: Install the Google tag (`gtag.js`) to measure website interactions

facts.fact: The Measurement Protocol allows sending server-to-server events to Google Analytics, complementing client-side tagging.
The 'Analytics for beginners and small businesses' learning path is intended for anyone new to Google Analytics or needing its fundamentals.
facts.quote: For anyone who's new to Google Analytics or simply needs to understand its fundamentals.
